parties.petitioner: State Rep. By Deputy Superintendent Of Police, Vigilance and Anti Corruption Chennai City-I Department

summary: Quashing of corruption proceedings under Section 482 Cr.P.C. after dismissal of discharge and revision petitions; inherent powers not to circumvent statutory bar under Section 397(3); test: prevent failure of justice; High Court erred in re-examining merits; proceedings reinstated; impugned quashing order set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(e), s.13(2)
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.239, s.397(3), s.401, s.482, s.483
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment quashing proceedings set aside; criminal proceedings restored.
